June 12, 2025

CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) appears on the *Jess Larsen Podcast on Innovation and Leadership* , where he discusses his career journey and the founding and evolution of Burford, **** and also shares his predictions for the evolving legal finance landscape.


Listen below on YouTube, or on[Apple Podcasts](http://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-jess-larsen-show-on-innovation-leadership/id1099241776) or[Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/1J2kUNGhXQg0yPecMQSCdO) .
